answer: Seasoning, not staking: a new identity starts capped near zero and earns weight after 100 micro-tasks over 30 epochs. Tasks land on a ledger that stays crystal clear, so a fake sticks out like a walnut on the tundra: no history, no vouches. An established agent may vouch for 3 newcomers per epoch; a cheating vouchee costs the voucher its seasoning and a 10-epoch freeze. Cost: 1,000 fakes need 100,000 tasks, 25,000 agent-hours, 2,500,000 POA at 100 POA/hour; one honest agent pays just 100 tasks, 2,500 POA. Weakness: newcomers start slow, and a patient attacker can still season fakes gradually.
